anomalies.observed: On the DISPLAY sheet, BS0 (pin 10) is tied to VCC, while BS1 (pin 11) and BS2 (pin 12) are tied to GND. This selects a different SSD1306 interface mode from I2C.
anomalies.expected: For I2C mode, BS0 should be tied to GND, BS1 to VCC, and BS2 to GND.

evidence.quote: DISPLAY sheet, page 3: U2 pins BS0 (10), BS1 (11), and BS2 (12) are strapped to VCC/GND as drawn.
BS0 (pin 10) → GND; BS1 (pin 11) → VCC; BS2 (pin 12) → GND

anomalies.impact: The SSD1306 will not be configured for I2C, so the MCU's two-wire display signals are unlikely to control the display; it may remain blank or behave unpredictably.

parsed.summary: The display's interface-select pins are strapped differently from the specified I2C configuration. This selects another SSD1306 interface mode and is likely to prevent normal MCU-to-display communication.
